lines.text: While the money was being brought out, Hilkiah the priest found the Book of the Law given by Aaron.
Shaphan reported on the money paid to the workers and read the book to the king, who tore his clothes.
The king sent Hilkiah and four others to inquire of the LORD, and they went to Huldah the prophetess.
Huldah said the LORD would bring calamity because the people had forsaken Him and burned incense to other gods.
The king read the book to all the people, then made a covenant standing by the altar.
